basic_details.job_title: GRSA Resource Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Road Safety Authority (ગુજરાત રોડ સેફ્ટી ઓથોરિટી), Gandhinagar, is engaging 2 Resource Persons for the PM-RAHAT Scheme on a temporary, One Time Basis for 11 months, at a professional fee of Rs. 25,000 per month (all inclusive). The essential qualification is MBA / MCA / M.Sc. (IT) or an equivalent related qualification. Applications go by post to the Commissioner or by email to [email protected], and the last date is 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application with the candidate details the notice makes compulsory: name, address, date of birth, mobile number (with WhatsApp) and email address.
Give educational details for Class 12, Bachelor Degree, Master Degree and any additional qualification, each with stream, board/university, year of passing and percentage/CGPA.
Give work experience, if any: name of the organisation, period, post held, and main work/role.

To apply by post, address it to: Commissioner, Gujarat Road Safety Authority, First Floor, Office of the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, near Police Bhavan, Sector-18, Gandhinagar – 382007, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
Write "Application for Resource Person – PM-RAHAT" clearly on the application cover.
Alternatively, send the application by email to [email protected]. The notice gives no email subject line.
The notice lists no separate documents to enclose.
important_instructions: The engagement is temporary and on a One Time Basis for 11 months. Gujarat Road Safety Authority may assign other work to the Resource Persons. For queries, the notice prints the phone number 079 23258148 and the email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: GRSA Resource Person at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: 11 months; temporary and One Time Basis
Rs. 25,000/- per month (all inclusive), called professional fee

content_sections.heading: About GRSA
content_sections.text: Gujarat Road Safety Authority is a Gujarat government body with its office in Gandhinagar, headed by the Road Safety Commissioner. This notice is for professional services to monitor the PM-RAHAT Scheme in the state, implement it and coordinate with various departments and stakeholders.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a desirable qualification, a minimum experience or an age limit. The application format asks for work experience "if any", so experience is not shown as compulsory. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility position.

rows.essential_qualification: MBA / MCA / M.Sc. (IT) or equivalent related qualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The professional fee is Rs. 25,000/- per month, described as all inclusive (તમામ સહિત). The engagement is for 11 months on a temporary and One Time Basis. The notice names no separate allowance.

content_sections.heading: GRSA Resource Person Job Description
content_sections.text: Monitoring of the implementation of the PM-RAHAT Scheme, data compilation and reporting. Work and follow-up on portals and IT-based systems such as eDAR, PFMS and TMS. Coordination with District Collector offices, the Police Department, the Health Department, SHA, NHA and other stakeholders. Assisting with scheme-related correspondence, documentation, data analysis, presentations and progress reports. Other work assigned by Gujarat Road Safety Authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GRSA Resource Person
content_sections.text: Prepare the application with the candidate details the notice makes compulsory: name, address, date of birth, mobile number (with WhatsApp) and email address. Give educational details for Class 12, Bachelor Degree, Master Degree and any additional qualification, each with stream, board/university, year of passing and percentage/CGPA. Give work experience, if any: name of the organisation, period, post held, and main work/role. To apply by post, address it to: Commissioner, Gujarat Road Safety Authority, First Floor, Office of the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, near Police Bhavan, Sector-18, Gandhinagar – 382007, Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Write "Application for Resource Person – PM-RAHAT" clearly on the application cover. Alternatively, send the application by email to [email protected] . The notice gives no email subject line. The notice lists no separate documents to enclose.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After the last date, the office committee scrutinises the applications. Eligible candidates are invited for an interview. The final selection is decided by the committee. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is temporary and on a One Time Basis for 11 months. Gujarat Road Safety Authority may assign other work to the Resource Persons. For queries, the notice prints the phone number 079 23258148 and the email [email protected] .
